premise: Maya sets up the newest corner of the base one thing at a time: the seismometer unfolds, the solar panel opens out, and last of all the flower in its box, for company.
inspiration: The three tasks of the folk tales, turned: three things built rather than three trials, and the last is the most important.
lesson: Save room for the thing that makes a place feel like home.

en-US.title: Three Jobs for Maya
en-US.text: Today, {woman:enter} Maya was setting up the newest corner of the base. Three jobs. One astronaut. {woman:face happy} Job one: the {seismometer:enter} seismometer. It unfolded on its three little feet, its dome shining. {seismometer:live} {sfx:blip} Its light blinked once. Listening! {woman:hop} Job two: the {solar-panel:enter} solar panel. Out opened its folding stand, and its sixteen blue cells. {solar-panel:live hold} Then it tilted up toward the Sun, and stayed there, soaking up the light. {sfx:hum} {woman:live} Maya gave it a thumbs up. {seismometer:pulse} Two jobs done! [curious] Job three was the most important. {woman:pulse} She'd been saving it for last. [short pause] A sealed box, with one orange {flower:enter} flower inside, under its pink-purple lamp. {woman:face surprised} [gently] Even in its box, it looked so bright against all that grey. {flower:glow 0.5} {woman:says} [warmly] “There. A listener, a helper… and a friend.” [happily] {woman:hearts} {flower:sparkle} And Maya sat down among them, very pleased with her new corner.

es-ES.title: Tres tareas para Maya
es-ES.text: Hoy, {woman:enter} Maya estaba montando el rincón más nuevo de la base. Tres tareas. Una astronauta. {woman:face happy} Tarea uno: el {seismometer:enter} sismómetro. Se desplegó sobre sus tres patitas, con su cúpula brillante. {seismometer:live} {sfx:blip} Su luz parpadeó una vez. ¡Escuchando! {woman:hop} Tarea dos: el {solar-panel:enter} panel solar. Abrió su soporte plegable y sus dieciséis celdas azules. {solar-panel:live hold} Luego se inclinó hacia el Sol, y allí se quedó, empapándose de luz. {sfx:hum} {woman:live} Maya le levantó el pulgar. {seismometer:pulse} ¡Dos tareas hechas! [curious] La tercera era la más importante. {woman:pulse} La había guardado para el final. [short pause] Una caja sellada, con una {flower:enter} flor naranja dentro, bajo su lámpara rosa y morada. {woman:face surprised} [gently] Incluso en su caja, se veía tan alegre entre tanto gris. {flower:glow 0.5} {woman:says} [warmly] «Ya está. Alguien que escucha, alguien que ayuda… y una amiga.» [happily] {woman:hearts} {flower:sparkle} Y Maya se sentó con ellos, muy contenta con su rincón nuevo.

blip.prompt: a single soft electronic blip, calm

hum.prompt: a small electric motor humming softly as a solar panel tilts, smooth and slow
